front: What runs underneath a Fabric eventstream?
back: An Event Hubs namespace plus the Stream Analytics engine; it exposes a Kafka endpoint. Producer Event Hubs hay Kafka chỉ cần đổi connection string.

ref.label: Eventstream for Event Hubs and Stream Analytics users

front: Eventstream limits: message size, retention, delivery guarantee
back: 1 MB per message, up to 90 days retention, at-least-once delivery. Consumer phải chịu được duplicate.

front: Default stream vs derived stream
back: Default stream = raw events from the sources; derived stream = output of operators such as Filter. Cả hai hiện trong Real-Time hub và route được tới nhiều đích.

front: Eventhouse destination: Direct ingestion vs Event processing before ingestion
back: Direct ingestion writes events as-is; event processing runs operators (filter, aggregate) before writing. Có operator trước eventhouse thì chọn chế độ thứ hai.

front: Destination does not accept operators directly (for example custom endpoint)
back: Add a derived stream as the operator output, then attach the destination to it. Derived stream làm cầu.

ref.label: Process events with the event processing editor

front: Lakehouse destination produces small files
back: Raise Minimum rows (1 to 2 million) and Maximum duration (1 minute to 2 hours); run Optimize table in notebook. Giá trị nhỏ sinh nhiều file.

front: CDC snapshot missing after publishing an eventstream
back: Clear Activate ingestion, publish, then activate with a Custom time earlier than publish. Ingestion có thể chạy trước routing.

front: Update policy: when does it run and on what data?
back: During ingestion, on the newly ingested batch only; source and target in the same database. Schema output phải khớp kiểu và thứ tự cột target.

front: Update policy IsTransactional default
back: false. Set true in production so a failed policy fails the whole ingestion and nothing is lost silently.

front: Need an always-fresh aggregation in KQL
back: Materialized view, not update policy; update policies aggregate only within one ingestion batch. Materialized view gộp phần đã materialize với delta.

front: materialized_view('V') vs querying V
back: materialized_view() reads only the materialized part: faster, may be slightly stale. Query V trả kết quả luôn mới.

front: .create materialized-view backfill default
back: backfill=false: only data ingested from now on; backfill=true needs the async keyword. Backfill lỗi tạm thời không tự retry.

front: Five window types in eventstream
back: Tumbling, hopping, sliding, session, snapshot; max window size 7 days, output at window end. Snapshot chỉ cần GROUP BY System.Timestamp().

front: Spark window(col, '10 minutes', '1 minute') is which eventstream window?
back: Hopping (Spark calls it a sliding window). Eventstream sliding chỉ ra kết quả khi event vào hoặc ra window.

front: Session window parameters
back: Timeout, maximum duration, optional partition key. Spark dùng session_window(); KQL dùng row_window_session().

front: KQL: show empty time bins as zero
back: make-series ... default = 0 on Timestamp step 5m; summarize by bin() skips empty bins. bin() làm tròn xuống bội số của bin size.

front: Spark trigger to process all available data then stop
back: trigger(availableNow=True); trigger(once=True) is deprecated. Available-now chạy nhiều micro-batch rồi dừng.

front: Spark streaming in production must restart automatically
back: Spark job definition with a retry policy and a dedicated checkpointLocation. Notebook chỉ để phát triển và test.

ref.label: Data streaming into a lakehouse with Spark

front: OneLake availability on an eventhouse
back: Exposes KQL tables as Delta in OneLake at no extra storage cost; while on, no rename, column type change, delete, truncate or purge. Ghi ra OneLake có thể trễ tới 3 giờ.

front: Activator actions
back: Teams, email, Power Automate, pipeline, notebook, Spark job definition, dataflow, copy job, User Data Function. Rule theo dõi state từng object.
